vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.0: §7Controller block for the Eye of Wood
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.1: §7You'd better do a sanity check, if you are looking at this.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.2: §7Can only be deployed in the Overworld, otherwise it will have a festive effect.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.3: §7This machine will constantly consume §9Water§7 and §cLava§7 in Input Hatches and store it inside the machine, like the Eye of Harmony.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.4: §7The success rate of processing depends on the amount of water and lava stored inside the machine.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.5: §7Maximum success rate: 75% when the stored water and lava are both exactly 256,000L.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.10: §9dW§7 is the difference between stored water and demand (256,000L) divided by 1000, rounded down: §9dW§f = floor( |Stored Water - Demand| / 1000 )
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.11: §cdL§7 is the difference between stored lava and demand (256,000L) divided by 1000, rounded down: §cdL§f = floor( |Stored Lava - Demand| / 1000 )
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.13: §7The machine takes a constant 60 seconds per run.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.14: §7On success, it performs 8 weighted Overworld ore-vein rolls and outputs large amounts of Overworld ore resources (dusts and gems).
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.15: §7On failure, it outputs a large amount of Steam.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.16: §7Amount of steam produced (in L) = Success Rate × 360,000,000L (max. 270,000,000L)
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.17: §7The controller is at the front center; input/output hatches may be placed on any steam machine casing.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.tooltip.18: §7Structure is identical to the Eye of Harmony (33×33×33); use the multiblock preview to view it.
vividtech.machine.eye_of_wood.no_veins: No Overworld ore vein data found
vividtech.machine.dream_elevator.tooltip: §7A steam-era industrial center dreaming of space.
§7The central acceleration rails determine module slots and processing bonuses.
vividtech.machine.steam_industrial_proce: §7An independent steam processing module slotted into the Dream Elevator.
§7Has its own item/fluid hatches; only receives shared steam from the host.
